notes.title: Weapon attachments and more! The new update is live! 🚀
notes.content:
Hello Hunters! 👨‍🚀

[b]Weapon attachments are here! [/b]
Today's update introduces long-awaited weapon attachments. From now on you can customize your weapons with barrel accessories, sights and lasers. 

Besides, we have a number of improvements for you. According to your requests, Motherships created manually will now become more "private".
On top of that, we have worked on a few aspects of looting to make it more enjoyable.

More details below:

[b]🔥New Features🔥[/b]

🔹Added Weapon attachments

[b]🚀Improvements🚀[/b]

🔹PvE Linked Maps: Mothership is now linked to Volcano on PvE if server was created manually. (No changes on PvPvE)
🔹PvPvE Mothership created manually no longer can be joined using "Random ship"
🔹Changed spawn positions/rotations of items to feel more natural
🔹Made changes to destroyable chests, so particles will be less likely to obscure items
🔹Changed sound and increased speed of force grabbing

[b]🛠️Fixes🛠️[/b]

🔹Typos in location names.
🔹Double-handed issues with the Vortex Rifle.
🔹Max capacity screen display at the evac capsule.
🔹Air Drop indicator overlapping the airdrop and players.
🔹Incorrect descriptions when applying mods to weapons.
🔹Various crafting issues.
🔹Player respawn issues on the Mothership.
🔹Flickering texts on crafting stations.

notes.title: A patch with Bug Fixes and a Few Improvements is now live! 🚀
notes.content:
Hello Hunters! 🧑‍🚀 

We’re excited to release a patch with[b] Bug Fixes and a Few Improvements[/b] , just in time for the weekend! 🚀
This update addresses some of the most critical issues, but it’s not the final patch – we’re still hard at work to ensure a smoother experience. 
If you encounter any problems, please report them to our team. We really appreciate your help!

  🛠️ [b]Fixes[/b]🛠️ 
[b]🔹Fixed multiple cases where the player might lose a save or be unable to extract from the Volcano.
🔹Fixed an issue where the player could lose a save when extracting, and the main menu loads instead of the Mothership.
🔹Fixed unresponsive aliens that were standing still and could not be killed.
🔹Fixed multiple cases for duplicating items (We are working on other cases).
🔹Fixed an issue where no new quest appears and the timer counts below 0.
🔹Fixed an issue where the extraction capsule takes off immediately after landing.
🔹Fixed an issue where the extraction capsule spawning loop could stop.
🔹Fixed a rare screen lock when extracting from a planet.[/b]
🔹 Fixed no quest marker or broken quest assigning timer after landing with another player on Volcano.
🔹 Fixed the issue where game modes fail to separate Users based on their mode selection when joining the same Ship number.
🔹 Fixed some cases that the item might remain suspended in mid-air.
🔹 Fixed an issue where the player disconnects due to a full game.
🔹 Fixed an issue where the quest radar could not be destroyed.
🔹 Fixed an issue where the user could duplicate the tablet.
🔹 Fixed an issue where quest objects were not taking frontal damaged.
🔹Fixed multiple bugs related to shooting. 
🔹 Fixed multiple bugs affecting enemies.

🚀 [b]Improvements[/b]🚀 
🔹 [b]Improved weapon interaction triggers to make it easier to reload and grab.[/b]
🔹 Added a room lifetime limit to improve servers stability.
🔹 Lowered animals hp and increased speed to be more realistic.

We encourage you to join our amazing community and meet the other Hunters in our [url=discord.gg/yTMDg7xgeC]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Dev Update #5
notes.content:
Hello Astro Hunters!🚀

[previewyoutube=Vh1uVNN-OzA;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
It's time for another update from the development of our game. We are excited to share the latest advancements and improvements we've been working on. Recently, our game was featured in the UploadVR Summer Showcase, so our team also worked on the video ➡️

Also, our free demo was available during Steam Next Fest. Thank you to everyone who played our demo and provided invaluable feedback and suggestions. Your input helps us make the game even better!


Don't forget to [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b] and stay tuned for more exciting developments!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715910/Astro_Hunters_VR/

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Weapon Handling[/h3]
Our team worked on weapon handling. You can now throw away weapons, switch them between hands, and perform awesome tricks! When you discard a weapon, it automatically disappears from your inventory. However, if you pick it up and place it on your belt or behind your back (as you put all the resources), it will seamlessly return to your inventory. Additionally, when you pick up a weapon, the corresponding magazine will automatically appear on your belt.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_030ae3ef4d114e99b192be4a35badd83~mv2.gif[/img]
[h3]Inventory System[/h3]
Our team has also been working on limited inventory. It is now divided into new categories and each category has its limits. This means you'll need to carefully choose what to bring on expeditions, leaving room to collect resources on the planet. But don’t worry—there's a perfect place for all your loot!

[h3]Storage Room[/h3]
Yes, here you will be able to store all your items! We’ve been hard at work on the Storage Room. From its design and graphics to its logic and mechanics. We hope you will like the result. Soon we will show you some sneak peeks on our social media and Discord.
 You can access your Storage Room from the Mothership. In the main room, there will be a control panel where you will be able to manage your storage rooms, unlock them, upgrade them to have more space, and buy new shelves. The rooms will be divided into: Resources, Crafting & Machinery, Storage and Armory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783366/7d683c85363d095a4b5d1923612bedf694de446b.jpg[/img]
[h3]Grenades[/h3]
Introducing grenades—something that wasn’t available during the demo! Each grenade has a unique effect. 
For now, four types of grenades are expected:
🔹Air Strike - starts a short air strike at the grenade blast location
🔹Healing Beacon - spawns a healing device that heals everyone around it
🔹Plasmatic Zone - a slowing zone ideal for closing choke-points
🔹Force Shield - a wall that blocks incoming damage
Players can take grenades from their tablet or directly from the wheel. We’re still fine-tuning the animations.

[h3]Crafting Stations[/h3]
Now, you can craft more than one item at once. That’s something we had on our to-do list and also this was something you asked for in the demo feedback. Before, only one item of a given type could be crafted at a time. Now, you can craft as many items as you have materials for. Don’t worry about using too many resources—the crafting station will automatically give you back any excess.
 
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_6be7e405887f40b7b31420a9da2f1398~mv2.gif[/img]
[h3]What’s more?[/h3]
[list]
[*]Safe zones: We added safe zones next to the Crafting Stations and the Commander where you can freely take out your resources without worrying that somebody can steal them. They are separated by blue barriers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783366/f7cbd75cbc6f4b32b74181d189619ad8313f32da.jpg[/img]
[*]Sound enhancements: We've refined the sounds of footsteps, animals, enemies and crafting stations.
[*]New UI: A new user interface has been implemented in the capsule and also in the watch. While on the planet, your watch will now display the time remaining until capsule extraction. It will also show the remaining operating time of the inhaler when in use.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783366/21ca6fde4dcdbe8071111bc0f6139e3f58221225.jpg[/img]
[/list] 
Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of this journey. 
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/yTMDg7xgeC]Discord Server[/url]! 💥

Follow us on our socials:
[url=https://www.facebook.com/AstroHuntersVR] Facebook [/url]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@astrohuntersvr] Tiktok [/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/AstroHuntersVR] X [/url]

notes.title: FREE demo available - try out Astro Hunters VR 🌌
notes.content:
Hello Astro Hunters!🚀

We have great news for you - our FREE demo is now available during Steam Next Fest!
Jump in, become one of the Hunters, and be the best! The demo gameplay lasts two hours.⏰


[h2]What will the demo include?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Undertake dangerous missions and challenge other players.
[*] You can join forces with other players, but be careful, hunting down other players to seize their valuable equipment is also an option! 
[*] Collect resources -  store them, sell for good money, or trade with other players.
[*] Craft new and better equipment.
[*] Gather a diverse range of weapons.
[*] Explore one of the planets with diverse landscapes, challenging enemies, and protected bases full of precious items.
[*] Beware of other players lurking on the planets for your loot!
[/list]
Don't forget to add the game to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715910/Astro_Hunters_VR/

Please keep in mind that this is a demo version, not an open beta - we're still working on new features and improving existing gameplay.  We wanted to give you a little glimpse of what this game will be about, and hear your feedback and thoughts as they are very valuable to us.

notes.title: Dev Update #4
notes.content:
Hello Astro Hunters! 🚀

Recently our Team has been quite busy developing Astro Hunters VR, but today we come to you with a fresh dose of information 📝

Don't forget to [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b] and stay tuned for more exciting developments!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715910/Astro_Hunters_VR/

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Resource Gathering[/h3] 

Gathering resources will be an important part of your interstellar adventure. For different resources, you will need different tools. We worked on their mechanics, animations and sounds.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_f2152894b31b4d9a93cb25e5fce8648f~mv2.gif[/img]

[h3]Work on UI[/h3]

Our team worked on the UI design among others of the main menu, enemies and UI at vendors on the Mothership and also on setting it up. Here you can see a short preview of what the menu looks like.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_47f3895530b24695a2db0fe4fea500dd~mv2.gif[/img]

[h3]What’s more?[/h3]

We reworked the mechanics of the crafting stations. Added sounds and names to the enemies and NPCs - we hope you’ll like them! On the Mothership you will be able to meet some vendors and buy and sell items - we’ve been also working on setting it up. 
Have you ever wondered how you will get on other planets? It will be possible thanks to the Capsule - just get in, choose the location and wait. Here is a little sneak peek at testing the Capsule start animation.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_35e37f20a5ad4eacaaa6756c82543df3~mv2.gif[/img]

Keep in mind that work on Astro Hunters VR is [b]still in progress[/b], and while these updates give you a taste of what's to come, the final version may differ. Thank you for reading our dev blog, for being part of our community and for your support.

Hello Astro Hunters! 🚀

We’re not slowing and we're thrilled to share our second dev update this February!

[h3]Elemental Mods[/h3]

Our team has recently been working on [b]Elemental Modifications [/b] for weapons. Each weapon will have one slot for an elemental modification. Weapons with elemental modifications will apply elemental effects on enemies. There will be four different mods: Fire, Plasma, Acid, and Electricity.

notes.title: Dev Update #2
notes.content:
Hello Astro Hunters! 🚀

Today we want to share some news about the the latest developments in our ongoing project!

[h3]The Mothership[/h3]

Our team has been recently reworking the Mothership. They focused on refining the overall look of the Mothership, working on textures, and adding new elements, also dynamic ones, to ensure the best immersive gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783366/1c2968122751171e04e94da385619f0ff951760f.png[/img]
We also set up statistics for many important game elements such as enemies, weapons, etc. What’s more, we added realistic reload to all the weapons! Check out what it looks like on one of the weapons:

[h3]Realistic Reload[/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_1732c0bed0db424bb98a0a7169f809e0~mv2.gif[/img]

[h3]Planets[/h3]

As you may have seen, on our socials we shared some sneak peeks from the planets. Let’s go outside the Mothership and have a look at them.

In our quest to provide an enriching gaming experience, we're investing significant effort into ensuring that our maps are not only distinct but also brimming with diversity. Our commitment lies in introducing a wide array of gameplay elements that will captivate and engage players.
But it's not just about looks – every planet won't just look different but will also have different resources, materials, enemies.... and gravitation! Of course, some of the elements may be similar or the same, but some of them will be unique only to a given planet.

Planet no. 1
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_146f95f1058d4ed390ba6d6769a7cc3a~mv2.gif[/img]

Planet no. 2
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_8275a82aa0ed4e90960a9248215b10f1~mv2.gif[/img]

Planet no. 3
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_f6ddcf36fc874bde9d8c75f68a74849c~mv2.gif[/img]

We're working hard to make sure playing our game feels like going on a big adventure, exploring all these awesome planets, and discovering new stuff each time you land on one. Please keep in mind, that the [b]game is still in progress[/b], so it may not reflect the final version.

Want to see more sneak peeks and learn more about the game?

notes.title: First Dev Update 🚀
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to our first dev update![/h1]

Hello Astro Hunters! 🚀

Great to have all of you here! Today, we're excited to pull back the curtain and give you a sneak peek into the Crafting Stations awaiting you on the Mothership. These stations are pivotal to your interstellar adventures, offering the means to gear up, prepare potions, enhance your arsenal, and ensure you're always ready for the challenges that lie ahead. 
Our team is still working on the mechanics of crafting stations but today we want to show you what they look like.

There will be 4 different crafting stations: 

[h3]Component Station [/h3]
Want to craft components and items? Use this station!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_46bf7ad390964616b9d85c184c2372d1~mv2.gif[/img]
[h3]Potion Station[/h3] 
Need to boost yourself? Visit the Potion Station.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_035bdaa4946f4f3e989b822285527b55~mv2.gif[/img]
[h3]Upgrade Station [/h3]
Prepare for the fight and update your weapons and tools here.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_aaa086785a744b7a86df896dc4259a54~mv2.gif[/img]
[h3]Fuel Station [/h3]
Station where the player crafts fuel for elemental attachments.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_01f7dff4e17043b484ea311a24ac4337~mv2.gif[/img]

Want to see more sneak peeks and learn more about the game? 
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/yTMDg7xgeC]Discord Server[/url]! 💥


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715910/Astro_Hunters_VR/
